_comment: Which model runs which phase, by tier — the one place to turn. Read by scripts/process/dispatch.py; measured by process_kpis.py models (telemetry module). Phases: plan, execute, review. A tier without an entry falls back to `default`. `command` is the project's way to start a worker session: {model} and {prompt} are substituted, the prompt is passed as ONE argument (never through a shell). `max_workers` caps concurrent dispatched sessions on this host. `runner`: `detached` (headless) or `tmux` (each worker a window of tmux session `tmux_session` — interactive, a human can open it; use a non -p command then, e.g. `claude --model {model} {prompt}`).
